title: Speed Intent story frontend cases toward 100 ms

intentCoverage.report:
Verdict: Caught. Checked revision 4d821cf4f6ccef8ed7185fb56b6f5f31e6062df3 (origin/main), story SEED-413#intent-story-cases-at-component-speed.

Promise: clicking a story card on the Development Board selects that story, and Intent then shows it as the selected story (data-selected-story on main "Intent").

Fault: dashboard/src/Columns.tsx:128 — the cards' `toggle` replaced with a no-op, so Backlog/Taken card clicks no longer change the page selection.

Command (scratch worktree at the revision): npm run --silent test:dashboard:frontend -- dashboard/frontend-tests/navigation/story-card-selection.spec.ts dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-sidebar-toggle.spec.ts dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-summary-story-comparison-sort.spec.ts

Evidence: baseline 6/6 passed. Under the fault 3 failed: story-card-selection.spec.ts:44 (`expectStoryHighlight`, board-reading-page.ts:148), intent-summary-story-comparison-sort.spec.ts:62 (`developmentCard(...).isSelected(true)` in `selectFromDevelopment`), intent-sidebar-toggle.spec.ts:77 (deselect never shows "No story selected"). Independent witness: a scratch copy of the sort spec without the `isSelected` checks failed at toHaveAttribute("data-selected-story", "SEED-B#b"), receiving "SEED-A#a". Claim bounded to Columns (Backlog/Taken) cards; the Recently done card path was not faulted. Correction to the delivery commit's claim: story-card-selection.spec.ts:150–170 checks a Recently done card; the Board card → Intent check is `selectFromDevelopment` in intent-summary-story-comparison-sort.spec.ts.

Restoration: fault reverted after each run, witness deleted, scratch state matched pre-probe, restored rerun passed 6/6, scratch worktree removed.

Wrap-up disposition: 4d821cf4f, Caught, no follow-up.
